thesis: Recapitalized metal additive manufacturing company with unique support-free laser powder bed fusion technology (Sapphire printers, Flow/Assure software) enabling true design freedom versus legacy AM for mission-critical aerospace, space, defense, semiconductor, and energy applications. Under new leadership, the company is pivoting to a recurring-revenue model via Rapid Production Solutions (RPS) and has opened its ~289,000 sq ft Livermore 'Forge 1' campus (built for 100+ printers) to triple production capacity. Q1 2026 revenue grew 48% YoY to $13.8M and FY2026 guidance calls for $60-70M revenue with >30% gross margin and EBITDA positivity in H2 2026. A late-June 2026 Morpheus Research short report alleging a 'sham' SpaceX relationship, a 3M-share resale registration, and a heavy capex/opex plan against thin cash make execution binary. Russell 3000/Microcap inclusion and fresh analyst coverage (Needham Buy $33) lift visibility. High-risk/high-reward speculative position, 1-3% sizing max.

drivers: FY2026 revenue lands at or above the high end of the $60-70M guide (>30% YoY) as Forge 1 capacity ramps
EBITDA positivity in H2 2026 removes the dilution overhang and validates the recurring-revenue RPS model
Support-free laser powder bed fusion moat wins repeat defense, space, and aerospace programs
Russell 3000/Microcap inclusion and new coverage (Needham $33, Cantor $17, Lake Street $20) broaden the institutional base
Morpheus short allegations are credibly rebutted, restoring the SpaceX/defense narrative

base_case.assumptions: FY2026 revenue lands within the guided $60-70M range; gross margin approaches but roughly hits the >30% H2 target; EBITDA breakeven arrives near schedule; capex/opex tracks guidance; modest dilution risk persists until profitability is confirmed; short-report controversy fades without material damage.

risks: Morpheus short allegations gain traction, damaging the SpaceX/defense narrative and credibility
EBITDA positivity slips past H2 2026 and the $40-50M capex plan forces dilutive financing
The 3M-share resale registration and speculative ETF (VELL) flows amplify volatility and overhang
Lumpy system sales and customer concentration produce a guidance miss
Micro-cap volatility (beta 2.52) and a $2.81–$31.75 52-week range magnify drawdowns

catalysts.event: Q2 2026 earnings — progress against the $60-70M FY2026 revenue guide and margin trajectory
>30% gross margin and EBITDA positivity milestone — the make-or-break inflection for avoiding dilution
Forge 1 / Livermore Production Campus capacity ramp toward 100+ printers to meet defense/aerospace demand
Progress toward the $60-70M FY2026 revenue guidance and Rapid Production Solutions (RPS) recurring-revenue traction
Resolution of Morpheus Research short-report allegations regarding the SpaceX relationship

key_risks: Morpheus Research short report alleging a 'sham' SpaceX relationship and 'SpaceX hype' rally — credibility and narrative risk
Path to EBITDA positivity in H2 2026 must land or dilutive financing follows given the $40-50M capex plan
3M-share resale registration creates a dilution/overhang risk amid ongoing cash needs
Lumpy system sales and customer concentration can produce guidance misses
Extreme micro-cap volatility (beta 2.52, $2.81–$31.75 52-week range) amplified by the VELL 2X single-stock ETF
